PaneDisplayMode.description: Pane placement and adaptive behavior. Default: Auto.

Auto: Choose Minimal below 641 DIP, Compact below 1008 DIP, otherwise Expanded.
Left: Always use an expanded left pane.
Top: Place navigation horizontally above content, with overflow.
LeftCompact: Use a compact left rail; opening overlays the content.
LeftMinimal: Hide the left rail; opening overlays the content.

ThemeMode.description: Explicit control palette. Default: Light; system preference is resolved by the host.

Light: Light surfaces, dark foreground, blue default accent.
HighContrast: Deterministic black/white/yellow contrast palette; custom OS colors are a host gap.

DisplayMode.description: Read-only effective layout computed by Rust from pane mode and available width.

Minimal: No persistent rail; also the effective display mode for Top.
Expanded: Pane and content are arranged side by side.

EventKind.description: Control events. PaneClosing alone permits synchronous cancellation.

SelectionChanged: Notification after the selected item changes.
ItemInvoked: Notification on invocation, including re-invoking the selected item.
BackRequested: Navigation request; the application owns its navigation history.
PaneOpening: Notification when the pane begins opening.
PaneOpened: Notification after the opening timeline completes.
PaneClosing: Set cancel=true during this callback to keep the pane open.
PaneClosed: Notification after the closing timeline completes.
ItemExpanding: Notification when a branch is expanded.
ItemCollapsed: Notification when a branch is collapsed.
Click: Button invocation notification; cannot be cancelled.
GotFocus: Scene node received real browser focus.
LostFocus: Scene node lost focus; pending activation is cancelled.
TextChanged: Committed editor text changed; composition drafts are separate.
Checked: The nullable checked state changed to true, before Click.
Unchecked: The nullable checked state changed to false, before Click.
Indeterminate: The nullable checked state changed to null, before Click.
Toggled: ToggleSwitch isOn changed; program updates also notify before returning to idle.
PasswordChanged: Password value changed; read the controller properties.
ViewChanged: Scroll/zoom presentation changed, including intermediate frames.
ValueChanged: ProgressBar range value changed; notification after coercion.
PointerEntered: Pointer entered the control; delivered when explicitly subscribed.
PointerExited: Pointer exited the control; delivered when explicitly subscribed.
MenuItemInvoked: Menu command or toggle was invoked.
CloseButtonClick: InfoBar close button invoked before its cancellable Closing event.
IsCheckedChanged: ToggleSplitButton checked state changed before Click.
ItemClick: Collection item primary invocation; fires before user selection updates.
RealizationChanged: Realized container set changed; used by host templates.
ItemsChanged: Collection source order or membership changed.
DragItemsStarting: Cancelable notification before an item drag starts.
Drop: Cancelable notification before committing a drop.
DragItemsCompleted: Drag session ended or was canceled.
IncrementalLoadRequested: The virtual viewport requests additional data.
ContextRequested: An item requests its context menu.
SelectedIndexChanged: Pager index changed after Rust coercion.
TabCloseRequested: Request to close a tab; the application owns removing its item.
AddTabButtonClick: The TabView add button was invoked.
TabDroppedOutside: A dragged tab was dropped outside the SDK tab strip.
CalendarDayItemChanging: A calendar day container was prepared.
FrameNavigationStopped: Scene Frame navigation cancelled without changing its journal.
DetailLabelRequested: Requests business data for an annotated scrollbar preview.
TextSelectionChanged: Rich text selection changed; UTF-16 offsets are supplied by Rust.
CopyRequested: The host may copy the Rust-selected text to the clipboard.
DragStarted: DragStarted notification from a Rust scrolling primitive.
DragDelta: DragDelta notification from a Rust scrolling primitive.
DragCompleted: DragCompleted notification from a Rust scrolling primitive.
Scroll: Scroll notification from a Rust scrolling primitive.
ConnectedAnimationCompleted: A connected animation reached its destination; payload contains its key.
Sorting: TableView Sorting notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
ClearSorting: TableView ClearSorting notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
CurrentCellChanged: TableView CurrentCellChanged notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
CellSelectionChanged: TableView CellSelectionChanged notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
BeginningEdit: TableView BeginningEdit notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
PreparingCellForEdit: TableView PreparingCellForEdit notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
CellEditEnding: TableView CellEditEnding notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
CellEditEnded: TableView CellEditEnded notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
CellDoubleTapped: TableView CellDoubleTapped notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
RowDoubleTapped: TableView RowDoubleTapped notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
ColumnReordering: TableView ColumnReordering notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
ColumnReordered: TableView ColumnReordered notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
TableViewChanged: TableView TableViewChanged notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
TableViewExport: TableView TableViewExport notification; request events support synchronous cancellation.
PasteFromClipboard: TableView clipboard paste request and completion. The request permits synchronous cancellation or text replacement.
Grouping: Community TableView column grouping request; setting cancel suppresses the default action.

Grid: Grid layout with pixel, auto and star tracks.
StackPanel: Sequential layout in the requested orientation.
TextBlock: Text measured and wrapped by the Rust layout engine.
Ellipse: Filled ellipse arranged in its grid cell.
ScrollViewer: Scrollable content viewport; scroll state belongs to Rust.

GridUnit.description: Grid track sizing unit. Default: Star.

HorizontalAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment inside the allocated slot. Default: Stretch.

VerticalAlignment.description: Vertical alignment inside the allocated slot. Default: Stretch.

Vertical: Arrange children from top to bottom.
Horizontal: Arrange children from left to right.

ClickMode.description: When Button raises Click. Default: Release.

Release: Click once on matching pointer/key release inside the control.
Press: Click once on initial pointer/key press.
Hover: Click on pointer entry; keyboard/pointer press does not invoke.

ControlState.description: Read-only common visual state; disabled takes precedence.

PointerOver: Pointer is inside the enabled control.
Pressed: A captured pointer or activation key is held.

NodeKind.description: Runtime node template. Use typed parent factory methods.

Button: Focusable source-traced button with arbitrary child content.
NavigationView: Existing NavigationView in the shared root surface.
Image: Decoded image resource drawn by the selected backend.
Ellipse: Noninteractive ellipse geometry using the shared scene layout and brush renderer.
ToggleButton: Button-derived checked control; owns nullable checked state in Rust.
CheckBox: Two/three-state checkbox; Space toggles, Enter is ignored by default.
RadioButton: Exclusive selection item; unnamed groups use siblings, named groups use the scene root.
RadioButtons: Column-major group of exclusive options with one Tab entry.
ToggleSwitch: Immediate two-state switch with pointer drag and Space activation.
ScrollViewer: Clipped scroll and zoom container with Rust-owned offsets.
PasswordBox: Masked password editor with independent reveal policy.
ProgressBar: Read-only range indicator with running, paused and error visuals.
ProgressRing: Active determinate or indeterminate progress visual.
RepeatButton: Button with a Rust timer while held; default Press.
Viewbox: Single child measured at natural size and scaled by source layout rules.
Canvas: Absolute position panel with attached offsets and Z order.
HyperlinkButton: Focusable link with Click and external navigation.
InfoBadge: Dot, numeric or icon notification badge.
FontIcon: Native FontIcon icon element; noninteractive and usable as control content.
SymbolIcon: Native SymbolIcon icon element; noninteractive and usable as control content.
PathIcon: Native PathIcon icon element; noninteractive and usable as control content.
BitmapIcon: Native BitmapIcon icon element; noninteractive and usable as control content.
ImageIcon: Native ImageIcon icon element; noninteractive and usable as control content.
AnimatedIcon: Native AnimatedIcon element in the shared Rust scene.
IconSourceElement: Native IconSourceElement element in the shared Rust scene.
Rectangle: Native Rectangle element in the shared Rust scene.
Line: Native Line element in the shared Rust scene.
Path: Native Path element in the shared Rust scene.
Polygon: Native Polygon element in the shared Rust scene.
Polyline: Native Polyline element in the shared Rust scene.
InfoBar: Inline notification with cancellable close and action/content slots.
PersonPicture: Circular profile picture, initials/group fallback and badge.
RatingControl: Interactive nullable rating with placeholder, caption and pointer/keyboard input.
SplitButton: Primary action with a separate flyout button.
ToggleSplitButton: Checked primary action with a separate flyout button.
CollectionItem: Rust-owned realized item container; lifecycle belongs to its collection.
AutoSuggestBox: Rust-owned AutoSuggestBox with a shared composition template.
NumberBox: Rust-owned NumberBox with a shared composition template.
ComboBox: Rust-owned ComboBox with a shared composition template.
ContentDialog: Rust-owned ContentDialog with a shared composition template.
TeachingTip: Rust-owned TeachingTip with a shared composition template.
CollectionHeader: Collection-owned group header; generated and recycled by ListView/GridView.
AppBarButton: Command button with icon and optional label.
AppBarToggleButton: Two/three-state command toggle with icon and label.
DropDownButton: Button with animated chevron and owned flyout.
CommandBar: Adaptive command collection with dynamic overflow.
CalendarView: Calendar grid with month, year and decade navigation.
CalendarDatePicker: Nullable date field with a calendar popup.
DatePicker: Locale-ordered date fields and confirmable wheel popup.
ColorPicker: HSV spectrum, preview, sliders and channel editors.
AppBarSeparator: Noninteractive separator shared by AppBar and command overflow templates.
ScrollView: Rust-owned modern scrolling host, sharing platform-neutral scroll mechanics.
SwipeControl: Rust-owned content swipe and command execution.
ContentControl: Single content host with native content alignment.
ContentPresenter: Template content presenter with padding and border layout.
Frame: Rust scene page journal, cache and navigation compositor.
ToggleMenuFlyoutItem: Two-state menu item with Rust-owned checked state.
RadioMenuFlyoutItem: Mutually exclusive menu item, grouped in the Rust scene.
MenuFlyoutSubItem: Nested menu owner using the shared Rust presenter.
RichTextBlockOverflow: Linked overflow container; its text content is supplied by the Rust flow engine.
ScrollBar: Standalone Rust range scroll bar with linked scrolling support.
Thumb: Pointer capture and original-coordinate drag events.
ScrollContentPresenter: Scrollable single content presenter using the Rust scrolling core.
ItemsPresenter: Header, items panel and footer presenter.
TableView: Community WinUI.TableView data grid; fixed source in references/table-view-source.json.
NavigationViewItemPresenter: The source-traced NavigationView item template presenter.
ItemsRepeaterScrollHost: A viewport host for ItemsRepeater inside a scrolling template.
RichEditBox: Editable rich text document; Rust owns formatting, selection and history.
SegmentedItem: Declarative item container owned by Segmented.

Canvas2D: Rust Canvas reference renderer with full existing NavigationView support.
WebGL2: Rust GPU renderer for shapes, text textures, clips and isolated layers; unsupported effects report errors.

Clip: Clip overflowing text using native LineServices metrics and layout-rounding compensation.
CharacterEllipsis: Trim at a grapheme boundary and append an ellipsis.
WordEllipsis: Trim at a whole-word boundary and append an ellipsis.
None: Render text normally without ellipsis; default native TextBlock fast layout path.

ImageStretch.description: Shared Image/Viewbox content scaling. The public Stretch name is an alias of ImageStretch.

Uniform: Preserve aspect ratio and fit inside the slot.
Fill: Fill the slot with independent horizontal and vertical scaling.
None: Use intrinsic image dimensions in logical pixels.
UniformToFill: Preserve aspect ratio, fill the destination and clip excess around its center.

AnimationEasing.description: Scalar animation easing. Default: EaseOut, from NavigationView indicator motion.

Discrete: Hold the preceding value until the target keyframe boundary.

AnimationResult.description: Exactly one terminal result for a public animation.

Cancelled: Explicit cancellation; presentation freezes at its current value.
Interrupted: A new animation or property update replaced this group.
Disposed: The target subtree or scene was destroyed.

EasingFunction.description: Fixed-source WinUI XAML easing function family.

Back: WinUI Back interpolator; evaluated by Rust.
Bounce: WinUI Bounce interpolator; evaluated by Rust.
Circle: WinUI Circle interpolator; evaluated by Rust.
Cubic: WinUI Cubic interpolator; evaluated by Rust.
Elastic: WinUI Elastic interpolator; evaluated by Rust.
Exponential: WinUI Exponential interpolator; evaluated by Rust.
Power: WinUI Power interpolator; evaluated by Rust.
Quadratic: WinUI Quadratic interpolator; evaluated by Rust.
Quartic: WinUI Quartic interpolator; evaluated by Rust.
Quintic: WinUI Quintic interpolator; evaluated by Rust.
Sine: WinUI Sine interpolator; evaluated by Rust.

EasingMode.description: How a XAML easing function applies its base curve. Default: EaseOut.

EaseOut: Reverse the base curve for deceleration.
EaseInOut: Apply the base curve to both half intervals.

GradientKind.description: Geometry of a panel background gradient; default geometry is explicit.

Linear: Interpolate colors along from/to endpoints; defaults to [0,0] endpoints (last stop).
Radial: Elliptical focal gradient; default center, origin and radii are [0.5,0.5].

BrushMappingMode.description: Coordinate space for gradient geometry. Default: RelativeToBoundingBox.

RelativeToBoundingBox: Coordinates are fractions of the arranged width/height.

GradientSpread.description: Behavior beyond the first gradient interval. Default: Pad.

Pad: Extend the first and last stop colors.
Reflect: Mirror the gradient in alternating intervals.
Repeat: Repeat the same gradient in every interval.

FontStyle.description: Style of a text run; default Normal.

Italic: Use the italic face or browser font synthesis.
Oblique: Use the oblique face or browser font synthesis.

Auto: Enable when content exceeds the viewport.

Disabled: Disable scrolling and hide the bar.
Auto: Show when content exceeds the viewport.
Visible: Always show the scrollbar when the axis is enabled.

Peek: Reveal while the reveal button is held, after user editing.
Visible: Display the password as normal text.

StretchDirection.description: Permitted Viewbox scaling direction. Default Both.

UpOnly: Scale up when needed; never shrink content.
DownOnly: Scale down when needed; never enlarge content.

Symbol.description: Built-in WinUI symbol; legacy values map to the pinned Fluent glyphs. Default Emoji.

FlowDirection.description: Direction of icon content; local icon scope, not complete application RTL layout.

RightToLeft: Right-to-left icon layout; mirroring follows the native icon policy.

IconSourceKind.description: Discriminator of a reusable typed icon source.

AnimatedIconSource.description: Pinned built-in animated visual; None displays the fallback icon.

None: No primary source; show fallback icon source.

FillRule.description: Rule for interior geometry; default EvenOdd.

PenLineCap.description: Shape stroke endpoint and dash cap. Default Flat.

Flat: Shape stroke endpoint and dash cap. Default Flat.: Flat.
Square: Shape stroke endpoint and dash cap. Default Flat.: Square.
Round: Shape stroke endpoint and dash cap. Default Flat.: Round.
Triangle: Shape stroke endpoint and dash cap. Default Flat.: Triangle.

OverlayPlacement.description: Preferred side of an anchored floating surface; flips and shifts within its Scene root. Default Auto.

Auto: Choose the first available side, starting above the target.
BottomEdgeAlignedLeft: Align left edges below the target; flip above and shift at the root boundary. Native SplitButton ShowAt default.
Left: Center to the left of the target.
Right: Center to the right of the target.
BottomEdgeAlignedRight: Bottom placement aligned with the anchor right edge.
RightEdgeAlignedTop: Place to the right aligned with the target top; flip or constrain at viewport edges.
LeftEdgeAlignedTop: Place to the left aligned with the target top; flip or constrain at viewport edges.

Command: Invoke an enabled command and dismiss the menu.
Toggle: Toggle checked state, invoke, and dismiss.
Submenu: Open a nested Rust MenuFlyout without executing.
Radio: Select one entry in its named group and dismiss.

InfoBarSeverity.description: Notification color and icon. Default Informational.

Informational: Informational Notification color and icon. Default Informational.
Success: Success Notification color and icon. Default Informational.
Warning: Warning Notification color and icon. Default Informational.
Error: Error Notification color and icon. Default Informational.

InfoBarCloseReason.description: Cause of a notification close request.

CloseButton: CloseButton Cause of a notification close request.
Programmatic: Programmatic Cause of a notification close request.

RatingItemKind.description: Rating item descriptor type. Default Font.

Font: Font Rating item descriptor type. Default Font.
Image: Image Rating item descriptor type. Default Font.

None: Focus and optional ItemClick, without selection.
Single: Keep at most one selected item.
Extended: Support Ctrl toggles and Shift range selection.

OpticalMarginAlignment.description: TextBlock optical alignment of glyph ink to its layout edge. Default: None.

None: Preserve the font side bearings; the native TextBlock default.
TrimSideBearings: Align leading/trailing glyph ink with the text layout edge; used by native Title/Subtitle styles.

Compact: Show spin buttons in a focus popup.

InvalidInputOverwritten: Restore the last valid value for invalid text.
Disabled: Retain invalid input and permit out-of-range values.

AutoSuggestionBoxTextChangeReason.description: Origin of an AutoSuggestBox TextChanged notification.

SuggestionChosen: Text changed by choosing a suggestion.

Copy: Insert copies and preserve the source.
Move: Move items, preserving their stable identities.
Link: Host-defined link operation; requires a drop handler.

CollectionChangeReason.description: Reason a collection source was changed.

ItemsUpdatingScrollMode.description: Scroll anchoring when an ItemsStackPanel source changes.

KeepItemsInView: Default. Preserve the first visible stable item and its viewport offset.
KeepScrollOffset: Preserve the current pixel scroll offset.
KeepLastItemInView: Preserve the last visible item; continue following appended items when at the end.

PipsPagerButtonVisibility.description: PipsPager navigation button policy. Default: Collapsed.

Visible: Keep the button space and show it when navigation is possible.
VisibleOnPointerOver: Show during pointer hover or keyboard focus.
Collapsed: Remove the button and its layout space.

None: Stop at the first and last finite page.
Wrap: Wrap between the first and last finite pages.

Multiple: Use hierarchical checkboxes with partial parent states.

Equal: Share strip width within native minimum and maximum tab sizes.
Compact: Show only the icon for unselected tabs.

TabViewCloseButtonOverlayMode.description: TabView close button visibility. Default: Auto.

Auto: Show selected close buttons, and unselected buttons during hover.
OnPointerOver: Show close buttons during pointer hover.
Always: Keep all closable tab buttons visible.

Default: Use the bar default, or Bottom when standalone.

CommandBarDefaultLabelPosition.description: Position of primary command labels. Default: Bottom.

Bottom: Place labels below icons when expanded.
Right: Place labels to the right of icons.

Compact: Keep the compact command row visible.
Minimal: Show a minimal strip and overflow button.
Hidden: Hide the command row until opened.

Auto: Show when secondary or dynamically overflowed commands exist.

KeyboardAcceleratorModifier.description: Modifier in a typed accelerator combination.

NavigationCacheMode.description: Page instance cache policy. Default Disabled; cache keys identify page types, independently of navigation parameters.

Disabled: Create a new instance on each navigation.
Enabled: Reuse instances in the Frame CacheSize bounded least recently used cache.
Required: Keep the page in the permanent cache, outside the transient cache budget. Pinned native source requires CacheSize >= 1 when first loading.

NavigationMode.description: Reason for a Frame page lifecycle notification.

New: A new journal entry, clearing the forward stack.
Back: Return to an earlier journal entry.
Forward: Return to a forward journal entry.
Refresh: Notify the current page again without adding history.

NavigationTransition.description: Frame transition recipe from pinned WinUI ThemeTransitions.cpp. Default Entrance.

Entrance: 150 ms outgoing phase and 300 ms incoming phase, with 140 DIP vertical entrance.
SlideFromLeft: Horizontal navigation entering from the left; reverse on back navigation.
SlideFromRight: Horizontal navigation entering from the right; reverse on back navigation.
Suppress: Commit immediately with no page animation.

CalendarViewSelectionMode.description: Calendar day selection policy. Default: Single.

DayOfWeek.description: First day of a calendar week. Default: Sunday.

ClockIdentifier.description: Time-picker clock convention. Default: host locale.

ColorSpectrumComponents.description: Axes represented by the spectrum. Default: HueSaturation.

CalendarIdentifier.description: Calendar system used by calendar selectors. Default: Gregorian.

Chinese: Chinese lunisolar calendar with leap months, traditional festivals and 24 solar terms (1901-2100, UTC+8).

WrapPanelItemsStretch.description: WrapPanel final source item sizing. Default None.

None: Keep every item at its desired size.
Last: Stretch the final source child into the remaining main-axis space.

Standard: Show primary and secondary commands with keyboard focus.
Transient: Initially show the primary row; More reveals secondary commands.

Inline: The open pane reserves content width.
CompactOverlay: A compact rail remains while the open pane overlays content.
CompactInline: A compact rail remains and opening reserves content width.

Left: Place pane on the physical left.
Right: Place pane on the physical right.

LightDismissOverlayMode.description: SplitView light dismiss tint; default Auto.

Auto: Use the platform default, without an overlay tint.
On: Tint the content while an overlay pane is open.

Relative: Offsets relative to the source viewport/content.

StandardCommandKind.description: Implements WinUI StandardUICommandKind for StandardCommand. None has no preset.

None: None standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Cut: Cut standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Copy: Copy standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Paste: Paste standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
SelectAll: SelectAll standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Delete: Delete standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Share: Share standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Save: Save standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Open: Open standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Close: Close standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Pause: Pause standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Play: Play standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Stop: Stop standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Forward: Forward standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Backward: Backward standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Undo: Undo standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.
Redo: Redo standard command metadata; execution remains application-owned.

ViewControlSlot.description: Rust layout slot for composed view controls.

RepeaterLayoutKind.description: RepeaterLayoutKind finite native values. Default: StackLayout.

UniformGridLayout: Uniform cells in wrapping rows or columns.
FlowLayout: Rust layout required by the pinned Gallery ItemsRepeater samples.
ActivityFeedLayout: Rust layout required by the pinned Gallery ItemsRepeater samples.
VariedImageSizeLayout: Rust layout required by the pinned Gallery ItemsRepeater samples.
LinedFlowLayout: Line-oriented aspect-ratio-aware layout, executed in Rust.

UniformGridLayoutItemsStretch.description: UniformGridLayoutItemsStretch finite native values. Default: None.

Uniform: Expand minor and major axes with a shared scale.

UniformGridLayoutItemsJustification.description: UniformGridLayoutItemsJustification finite native values. Default: Start.

Start: Align each line at its start.
End: Align each line at its end.
SpaceEvenly: Distribute equal spaces at edges and between items.

RefreshPullDirection.description: RefreshPullDirection finite native values. Default: TopToBottom.

TopToBottom: Pull down from the top edge.
BottomToTop: Pull up from the bottom edge.
LeftToRight: Pull right from the left edge.
RightToLeft: Pull left from the right edge.

RefreshVisualizerOrientation.description: RefreshVisualizerOrientation finite native values. Default: Auto.

Auto: Orient from the container pull direction.

RefreshVisualizerState.description: RefreshVisualizerState finite native values. Default: Idle.

Peeking: Overpan that cannot trigger a refresh.
Interacting: Eligible pull below the execution threshold.
Pending: Pull exceeded the threshold; release requests refresh.

FlowLayoutLineAlignment.description: Alignment of FlowLayout lines. Default Start.

SpaceEvenly: Share space at edges and between items.

Reveal: Expose actions until clicked or dismissed.
Execute: Invoke the single action after passing the source threshold.

Auto: Use ComboBox below 10 pages; NumberBox otherwise.
ButtonPanel: Use numbered page buttons with ellipses.

Visible: Keep the button visible; disable it at its edge.
HiddenOnEdge: Reserve space and hide the button at its edge.

None: Preserve item aspect ratios without filling leftover line space.
Fill: Distribute a line to the available width.

ThemeTransition.description: Rust layout transition recipe; attach to a node or its children.

Entrance: Translate and fade newly loaded content; staggering enabled by default.
Reposition: Animate layout offset changes without changing layout.
Content: Animate incoming content on load and text refresh.
AddDelete: Animate additions, removals and the positions of remaining nodes.

ConnectedAnimationConfiguration.description: Connected animation path. Gravity is the default.

Gravity: Curved connection with a vertical lift.
Direct: Direct connection between source and target.

AnimatedProperty.description: Scalar visual properties accepted by Rust animation and implicit transitions.

TranslationZ: Depth translation in DIP. Controls composition order and ThemeShadow elevation; default 0.

ExpressionProperty.description: Source channel read by a Rust expression binding.

ActualOffsetX: Arranged horizontal offset relative to the parent.
ActualOffsetY: Arranged vertical offset relative to the parent.
TranslationZ: Depth translation in DIP. Controls composition order and ThemeShadow elevation; default 0.

ExpressionOperation.description: Binary operation in a Rust expression tree.

Divide: Divide; nonfinite frames retain the previous presentation.
Modulo: Remainder; nonfinite frames retain the previous presentation.

TableViewColumnKind.description: Built-in TableView display and editing column. Default: Text.

TableViewSelectionUnit.description: Community TableView selection target. Default: CellOrRow.

CellOrRow: Cells and row headers select independently.
CellWithRow: A cell also selects its row.

TableViewRowDetailsVisibilityMode.description: Community row details policy. Default: VisibleWhenExpanded.

VisibleWhenExpanded: Show details when the row-header toggle is expanded.

NavigationViewBackButtonVisible.description: NavigationView back-button visibility. Auto follows the native desktop policy.

Collapsed: Hide the back button without reserving space.
Visible: Show the back button. IsBackEnabled controls invocation.
Auto: Use the native desktop policy, which shows the button.

NavigationViewOverflowLabelMode.description: Label on the NavigationView top overflow button.

MoreLabel: Show the More label beside the overflow icon.

NavigationViewSlot.description: Content slots owned and arranged by the Rust NavigationView template.

Header: Header content above the main content.
PaneHeader: Content beside the pane toggle and title.
PaneFooter: Custom content above footer menu items.
AutoSuggestBox: Search control, moved between left and top presenters.

Never: Do not change selection for shoulder input.
Always: Shoulder input moves between selectable top navigation items.
WhenSelectionFollowsFocus: Enable shoulder navigation only when SelectionFollowsFocus is enabled.

TableViewGroupState.description: Initial state for community TableView groups. Explicit per-group choices survive changes to the default.

Expanded: Show descendant groups and rows by default.
Collapsed: Show only group headers by default; this is the community default.

TableViewGroupSortMode.description: What orders group headers at a grouping level.

Key: Order by the original typed group key.
Count: Order by item count, breaking ties by key.

Default: Equal item sizes with a shared border and selection pill.
Pivot: Content-sized items with an underline selection pill.
Button: Content-sized buttons with an accent selected background.
